<thought>We need to apply the retrosynthetic template with ID 614 to the target product molecule (the flavanone). The product SMILES can be derived from the right‑hand side of the mapped reaction provided. Removing the atom‑mapping annotations gives the SMILES  
`COC1=CC2=C(C=C1)C1CCCC(C1)C(=O)C2`.  
We then apply the template to this SMILES to obtain all possible precursor sets.
